Toolkits

Toolkits to organize your own drive

Everything you need to mobilize your community: proven ideas, a printable checklist and ready-to-post captions.

Toolkit for churches

Your congregation can become an anchor for the mission in your neighbourhood.

What you can organize

  1. 01

    Food-drive Sunday

    A bin at the entrance for a month, an announcement every Sunday, a hand-over at month’s end.

  2. 02

    Outreach team

    Form a team of four that serves one Thursday a month, with a La Paix du Cœur guide.

  3. 03

    Prayer evening

    Dedicate a gathering to praying for orphans, widows and the homeless.

Checklist

  • Get your pastor’s or board’s approval
  • Pick the dates (ideally 4 Sundays)
  • Name one person in charge
  • Place a labelled bin at the entrance
  • Announce the drive every Sunday
  • Post the captions on social media
  • Write to us to plan the pick-up
  • Thank the congregation and share the result

Toolkit for schools

A classroom food drive teaches generosity hands-on — and it is often the most joyful one.

What you can organize

  1. 01

    Class challenge

    Each class fills its own box; the most generous picks the lunchtime music.

  2. 02

    Lunch boxes with love

    Students decorate lunch boxes that go out with the food baskets.

  3. 03

    A visit from us

    A volunteer presents the mission in 20 minutes, adapted to the students’ age.

Checklist

  • Get the principal’s approval
  • Let parents know by email or agenda
  • Prepare one box per class
  • Post the list of requested items
  • Plan a thank-you note for the students
  • Write to us to arrange the pick-up
  • Share a photo (no student faces)

  • Challenge complete: our classes collected [amount to confirm] for La Paix du Cœur. Well done, everyone! #LaPaixDuCoeur #Montreal #FoodDrive

Toolkit for businesses

A meaningful team activity close to home that brings colleagues together.

What you can organize

  1. 01

    Office food drive

    A bin in the shared kitchen for two weeks, with a challenge between teams.

  2. 02

    Volunteer day

    A team runs a grocery-store food drive on a Saturday, or assembles Christmas baskets.

  3. 03

    Matching gift

    The company matches employee donations up to a set amount [tax receipt if registered].

Checklist

  • Get management or HR approval
  • Choose the format (drive, volunteer day, matching gift)
  • Name two people in charge
  • Announce the activity internally
  • Place the bin or book the date
  • Write to us to plan
  • Post a thank-you on social media

  • For every dollar our employees give, we give one more. Goal: [amount to confirm]. #LaPaixDuCoeur #Montreal #FoodDrive
